featured_reviews.name: Azania Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Kaizad Patel — what can I say? There truly aren’t enough words to encapsulate the sumptuous wedding food he prepared for our reception. The experience was nothing short of unforgettable.

From the very beginning, Kaizad was accessible, professional, and instinctively understood exactly what a wedding crowd would love — from the starters right through to the main course. He is a culinary genius with an extraordinary eye for detail.

The care, precision, and attention to detail were evident not only in the flavours but also in the service and presentation. Every dish was served with clockwork timing, thoughtfulness, and respect for the occasion. The coordination, calm service flow, and seamless execution made guests feel truly looked after.

The patra nu macchi was absolutely delectable — with the perfect balance of spice and sweetness in the chutney, beautifully wrapped and steamed in a banana leaf. The pulao daal had just the right thickness, wholesomeness, and warmth. The sali jardalu(apricot) chicken was rich, comforting, and perfectly textured. The lagan nu custard was nutty, gently cinnamony, and deeply satisfying. One can go
on..

A particularly thoughtful touch was the bhonas, which were sent promptly between 2–4 pm on the day of our reception to guests who were unwell or unable to attend. That level of care meant so much, and everyone who ate his food had a truly memorable experience.

The thali selection was outstanding and thoughtfully inclusive for vegetarian and Jain guests. Having undhiyu available in winter was a rare and wonderful treat, and the overall spread was exceptional. In fact, a few people told us they came to the wedding especially for his food — which says it all!

Kaizad also caters for Navroz, weddings, and other festive occasions. If you’re looking for unforgettable wedding or festive catering, his cuisine is simply unmatched.
